motifs.name: central_cliff_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant central mountain complex: tall vertical cliffs, dark pine-topped ridgelines, split ravines, and mist-veiled lower slopes. Exclude the pavilion village and foreground trees below.
must_preserve: layered axe-cut and hemp-fiber rock strokes
dark ink washes on cliff faces
pale vertical ravine reserves
pine-needle silhouettes along crests
